name: Optimize Man: Gymcel
detailed_description:
Grotesque horror gym-sim survival game that delves into the absurdities of toxic self-improvement culture, mental health struggles, and internet subcultures.  Play as OptimizeMan, a regular guy grinding at the Hypermaxx Facility, where the pressure to level up physically and mentally slowly distorts reality.

Key Features:

  • Daily Todo List: Every morning you must pick 3 tasks out of a dynamically given pool, for your daily todo list.  Completing tasks returns game points and buffs, failing them returns penalty.

  • Stats That Matter: Track your muscle groups (symmetry is key), mental health, and money (because pre-workout and face surgery ain’t free).

  • Workout Minigames: Lift heavy, lift smart. Go for precision and risk big injuries for big gains, or play it safe with volume and avoid snapping your spine. Your call.

  • Social Simulator: NPCs talk gibberish, but they’re judging. Build friendships, pursue romance, or spiral into isolation. Social failure is as punishing as any missed rep.

  • Survival & Insanity: Keep your mental health in check or risk spiraling into madness or losing focus and receiving a deathly injury.  Permadeath applies.

  • Non-Linear Gameplay & Multiple Endings: Every run is unique. Will you last long enough to see the top of the leaderboard? Spiral into insanity and uncover shocking truths? Only your choices decide.

The Truth:

This game is raw, unfiltered, and brutally honest. It’s about the grind, the cope, and the harsh reality of blackpill. Whether you’re chasing gains, trying to fix your mental health, or just want to see how deep the rabbit hole goes, OptimizeMan: Gymcel has something for you.

short_description: Welcome to the Hypermaxx Facility. You are OptimizeMan, society’s default build. An average man dropped into a world that worships the extraordinary. Failure is not an option.
supported_languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes: Contains themes of mental illness, suicide, performance enhancing drug use (steroids), and mild grotesque violence (workout injury, accidental death).
